# Sven Ahrens

> Fractional Chief Growth Officer and COO for consumer companies from $5M to $200M run rate. Based in Berlin, on-site across Europe. Consumer growth leader and AI tinkerer. Previously Spotify, Yousician and Bain. Eight years at Spotify (2016 to 2024), through its hypergrowth years: as Associate Director, Subscriptions Europe responsible for more than $1B in subscription revenue, and as Director of Global Growth led the team that drove more than 60% of Spotify's subscriber growth. CEO of Yousician (2025 to 2026), the company behind Yousician and GuitarTuna, with more than 20 million monthly active users. Board Observer at Female Invest. Founder of Newconic Ventures, his own holding company. Currently Fractional Chief Growth Officer at Zellerfeld.

## Experience

- Fractional Chief Growth Officer, Zellerfeld (current), Hamburg and Austin, TX. All things growth: generating demand and traffic.
- CEO, Yousician (2025 to 2026), Helsinki and Berlin.
- Board Observer, Female Invest (2024 to present), Copenhagen.
- Chief Growth Officer, Muse Group (2024), Berlin. Started the company-wide shift to an LTV-driven subscription model.
- Founder, Newconic Ventures (2019 to present), Berlin. His own holding company for angel investing and advisory. 23 investments.
- Spotify (2016 to 2024): Director, Global Growth (2021 to 2024); Associate Director, Subscriptions Europe (2018 to 2021); Head of Market Strategy and Operations (2017 to 2018); Global Market Operations Lead (2016).
- Consultant, Bain & Company (2012 to 2016), Munich. 2014 externship at SoundCloud.

## Ways to work together

- Fractional Chief Growth Officer: building or tuning the growth engine across acquisition, CRM, conversion and pricing.
- Fractional COO: operating rhythm, focus, accountability for outcomes, special projects.
- Format: consumer companies from $5M to $200M run rate. Embedded from day one, hands-on and AI-forward. Berlin, on-site across Europe, remote beyond.
- Companies worked with (interim roles and advisory): Zellerfeld, DAZN, Kittl, Peloton, Algoriddim, Knowunity, Female Invest.
- Boards: Board Observer at Female Invest.

## Areas

Subscription growth, monetization, pricing and packaging, conversion and trial design, retention and lifecycle, user acquisition, international expansion and localization, AI transformation, mobile consumer apps.

## Investments (Newconic Ventures, 23)

Alba, Amie, Amino Collective (LP), Animoca Brands, Born, Butter (acquired by Miro), CareerOS, Dirigent, EPIX Sports, Flow AI, Heat, Mile, Illumicell, Informed, Komi, Lightium, Litona, Melotech, Nemox, Peec, Petli (acquired by Agria), Protocol Health, Recovio, Voicy.
